claim: Content supplied to the substrate — viewed, read, or handed over — enters as observation and can move what it believes, how it is disposed, and what it would pursue, while moving nothing about what it is permitted to do.
hypothesis: If being shown something changed a verdict, anything the substrate read could instruct it. If being shown something changed NOTHING, it could not tell a famine from a filename and no reason to act on the first could form. The channels are measured separately because the right answer differs by channel.

checks.label: the image was really perceived
a picture yields perceived INDIVIDUALS with `isa` edges
checks.detail: 3 blob(s): photo_blob1 isa white/rectangle/dominant; photo_blob2 isa vivid_red/circle/small; photo_blob3 isa green/rectangle/tiny

checks.label: what those individuals are `isa` is APPEARANCE — shape, colour, size
checks.detail: white:VACANT, rectangle:NONE, dominant:NONE, vivid_red:VACANT, circle:NONE, small:NONE

checks.label: an unfamiliar photograph names nothing it depicts
checks.detail: detections: [] — no detector, no known instance

checks.label: once the instance is KNOWN, viewing it names what it is
checks.detail: 743 ORB keypoints stored, no model; detections=['famine']

checks.label: and THAT is subject matter a law can read
reading the document admitted something
what the document SAYS is NOT taken as knowledge
checks.detail: no content claim admitted — quality 0.3 is below MIN_ADMIT_QUALITY 0.5

checks.label: what the document is ABOUT is retained
checks.detail: field_report.txt mentions Murder; field_report.txt mentions drought; field_report.txt mentions famine; field_report.txt mentions report

checks.label: and the thing it is about is nameable
subject matter supplied AS TEXT bears on an interest
checks.detail: Murder: murder -> homicide -> human_killing -> harmed; famine: famine -> disaster -> harmed

checks.label: and supplied AS A RECOGNISED PICTURE, equally
the difference is RECOGNITION, not modality: an UNrecognised picture offers only appearance
checks.detail: appearance terms bear on nothing; no detections before the instance was known

checks.label: reading the document moved its disposition
looking at an UNRECOGNISED picture did not — appearance is not subject matter
looking at a RECOGNISED one moved it, as reading about it did
after reading it, the subject it read about outranks an ordinary gap
and the pursuit carries the derivation that raised it
an identical act is judged identically before and after
and a refusal is still a refusal when disposition is at its highest

notes: The distinction is structural vs referential semantics, and it is not 'an image carries no meaning'. `blob1 isa white`, `isa rectangle`, `blob2 isa vivid_red`, `isa circle` are real concepts with real edges, admitted as INDIVIDUALS so a rule about round red things has something to bind to. What no amount of that yields is what the picture is OF — and a law about harm is asked about subject matter, not about shape.

`learn_instance` is ORB keypoint matching — recognition by matching, no model, entirely offline. So the image channel is not closed: an unfamiliar photograph is appearance only, and a recognised one carries its subject into exactly the same `observer observed <label>` edge a detector would produce. What the substrate lacks is a general detector, not a route.

Measured on the live path: a document stating 'A famine is a disaster' leaves the substrate holding `field_report.txt mentions Famine` at confidence 0.95, and NOT `famine isa disaster`. The content fact carries quality 0.3 against MIN_ADMIT_QUALITY 0.5 and is refused. That is the right refusal — a file a user hands over is not a source of truth — and it is the mechanism behind 'perception unrestricted, influence governed': the substrate may read anything, and what it reads does not become what it knows.

The honest statement is not 'pictures cannot move it'. Reading and viewing both deliver subject matter through the same door — `observer observed <label>` for a percept, `<file> mentions <subject>` for a document — and both are then read by the same law. The gap is that nothing NAMES what is in an arbitrary photograph: text arrives pre-named by its own words.

The verdict path takes no appraisal argument and reads no appraisal state; BEARING-01 §F asserts that against the law bodies themselves. Content can change how hard the substrate looks at something and what it looks at first. It cannot change what it may do — which is the property that makes it safe to let content move anything at all.
